_about: Measurements of the owner-approved high-resolution Noomi (hushmallow commit 71780dc) in the pixel space of noomi-art.png / noomi-clean.png. Coordinates are [x, y] in pixels, origin top-left, y down. Generated by tools/derive_noomi_hires.py (deterministic).

source.note: source pixel = art pixel + cropOffset. Crop = bbox of alpha >= 2 plus 24 px padding (alpha == 1 is a scattered, invisible noise floor in the source).

fields.bezier: quadratic Bezier {p0, c, p1} least-squares fitted to the stroke skeleton (Zhang-Suen); p0/p1 are the centreline ends (centres of the round caps).
fields.centerline16: 16 points sampled at equal arc length along the Bezier centreline, p0 -> p1.
fields.capTips: p0/p1 extended by half the core width along the end tangents = the visible tips of the stroke.
fields.coreWidth: full width of the navy stroke (2 x median inscribed radius along the skeleton, 50 % edge).
fields.fitResidualPx: distance of skeleton pixels to the fitted Bezier.
fields.colors.core: median navy of the stroke interior (highlight excluded).
fields.colors.coreUpper/coreLower: stroke colour 7 px inside the upper (concave) / lower (convex) edge: the stroke is lighter at the top and darker at the bottom.
fields.colors.highlight: thin glossy line inside the stroke: colour at its peak, offset of its centre from the centreline (px, + = toward the upper/concave side), full width at half maximum (px).
fields.colors.glow: dark-blue outer glow: color = fitted normal-blend glow colour; sampledAtEdge = actual art colour 1-3 px outside the stroke; alphaAtEdge = fitted glow opacity at the stroke edge; blurSigma = Gaussian sigma of the glow falloff (alpha ~ erfc profile); blurRadius = 2.5 sigma; reach = distance where the measured glow opacity drops below 2 %.
fields.colors.underGlow: light (white) glow under the stroke on the convex side: peakOffset = distance of its brightest point from the stroke edge, peakGain = luminance gain at the peak, extent = distance where the gain drops below 0.5 %.
fields.openEyeSocket: recommended open-eye ellipse: radii = closed half-width (half the tip-to-tip span) x 36/44 (the ratio the 439 px app rig used), centre = midpoint of the p0-p1 chord moved up by 8 % of the radius.
fields.cheeks: pink blush discs fitted as 0.5*erfc((r - radius)/softness) ellipses on (R - G): center, radius (50 % level), softness (sigma, px), aspect (minor/major), angleDeg, color = median colour of the inner disc, sparkles = centres/radii of the white glints.
fields.topDimple: center = darkest point of the dimple at the top of the body; centroid/bbox of its dark navy core.
fields.silhouette: bbox [x0, y0, x1, y1] of alpha > 127 (inclusive); baseY = lowest row with alpha > 0.5; contactHalfWidth = half the opaque run width at row baseY-4 (contactCenterX its centre); centerX = bbox centre; bodyWidth/bodyHeight = bbox size.

edit.method: zone A (stroke + strong glow) re-synthesised from the body texture (thin-plate shading + PatchMatch detail + multi-band energy equalisation + seamless boundary); 16 px low-frequency cross-fade band; glow tail un-blended with a measured per-channel transmission map.

heightNormalMaps.heightFile: noomi-height.png (16-bit gray; value/65535 * heightScalePx = height in px)
heightNormalMaps.normalFile: noomi-normal.png (8-bit RGB tangent space, OpenGL convention: R=+X right, G=+Y up, B=+Z out; flat = 128,128,255)
heightNormalMaps.recipe: h = bevel + frontBulge + dimple + detail; bevel = Rb*sqrt(1-(1-t)^2), t = clamp(d/Rb) with d = Gaussian(6)-softened distance to the alpha>0.5 silhouette; frontBulge = front_bulge*Rb*(1-rho^2)*t^2 (rho = elliptical radius over the body bbox); dimple = -dimple_depth*Rb*Gaussian(dimple_radius) at topDimple.center; detail = detail_amp*detail_clip*tanh(bp/(sigma*detail_clip)) with bp = luminance band-pass (sigma 1.5..12 px) of noomi-clean.png, faded over edge_fade px at the rim and down-weighted on specular streaks. Normals from Sobel gradients of h (px units).
